page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.small is an entry-tier general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor. The instance is allocated one dedicated vCPU mapped to a single physical core and thread from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The CPU subsystem features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates vector and cryptographic instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES.

System memory is sized at 4.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM balance. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent data. In synthetic testing, memory throughput reaches 8.66 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 6.89 GB/sec for uncached write operations. Computational benchmarks demonstrate baseline output, registering a Geekbench single-core and multi-core score of 944.0, a PassMark CPU score of 1304.39, and a PassMark memory score of 967.62.

Network and application performance tests show Redis SET throughput of 1.3 million operations per second and static web serving throughput of 1.3 GB/sec. Across broader multi-core benchmarks, overall throughput is constrained by the single-thread allocation. The server provides a low resource footprint suitable for cost-sensitive environments. It fits non-critical workloads, such as lightweight utility tasks, development and test instances, low-traffic web endpoints, and minimal microservices that do not demand extensive concurrent compute.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.small is a baseline general-purpose virtual machine configured with one vCPU and 4.0 GB of memory. It runs on an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on a KVM hypervisor. The CPU configuration provides a single dedicated physical thread with 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and access to 35 MB L3 cache, supporting instruction extensions including AVX-512 and AES. The instance contains no bundled local storage and includes zero dedicated GPUs, operating exclusively via network-attached storage. Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-tier capacity across computational tasks, with a single-core Geekbench score of 944.0, a PassMark CPU score of 1304.39, and static web serving throughput reaching 1.3 GB/sec. Given its modest throughput and standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, ecs.n2.small offers a low-cost footprint appropriate for auxiliary services, low-load background workers, dev-test environments, and small administrative microservices.
